**STEP 2 - Ruler:** The white square plate is about 26 cm across. Its area is roughly 580 cm² after allowing for the rounded corners.

**STEP 3 - Items:** Roast potatoes, roast chicken (with skin), carrot slices, mushrooms. No visible sauce or oil pool.

**STEP 4 - Area:** Potatoes about 12% (~70 cm²), chicken about 15% (~87 cm²), carrots about 7% (~40 cm²), mushrooms about 9% (~52 cm²). Food covers about 43% of the plate.

**STEP 5 - Volume:** Potatoes ~70 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 140 ml. Chicken ~87 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 130 ml. Carrots ~40 cm² × 1.2 cm ≈ 48 ml. Mushrooms ~52 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 104 ml.

**STEP 6 - Grams:** Potatoes 140 × 0.7 ≈ 98 g. Chicken 130 × 0.95 ≈ 124 g. Carrots 48 × 0.6 ≈ 29 g. Mushrooms 104 × 0.6 ≈ 62 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Potatoes 98 g × 130 kcal/100 g ≈ 127 kcal. Chicken 124 g × 190 ≈ 236 kcal. Carrots 29 g × 35 ≈ 10 kcal. Mushrooms 62 g × 35 ≈ 22 kcal. Total ≈ 395 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** About 310 g of food on a partly covered 26 cm plate, with roughly 400 kcal, is plausible for a moderate main-course portion.
